hook.text: Connect two swing lows in an uptrend with a straight line. That line—a trendline—shows where buyers step in.

buildup.text: Uptrend lines connect rising lows. Downtrend lines connect falling highs. Both reveal the trend's angle.

discovery.text: A trendline needs at least two touches to draw and three to confirm. More touches mean greater reliability.

twist.text: Most trendlines eventually break. The break isn't always a reversal—it can be a slowdown into a range.

climax.text: Trendlines are subjective—two traders can draw different ones. Use them as guides, not gospel.

punchline.text: A line on a chart is a hypothesis, not a law.

quiz.question: How many touches confirm a trendline?
